doc.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview

chapter: Monk, Ellington and Archie Shepp in the 1970s
title: Emphysema and convulsions
summary: Ware is told he has emphysema and has alcohol convulsions, helped by his wife.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: On tenor. Two tenors and we had a swinging time. Then -- what happened during that period? Oh, that's the time that my health really started failing. I wouldn't stop smoking cigarettes and I went to see the doctor. In fact, my lungs had been weak. He told me, 'I think you have emphysema.' That really didn't frighten me because I was fighting this alcohol and A.A. I'd make it a day or two and slip. I started having convulsions. Well, I was in kind of bad shape.
